name: What can go wrong if the electrical subs are not coordinated with the rest of the project?
description: Without coordination, trades can block each other, miss rough-in points, and trigger rework, inspection issues, and extra costs.

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong if the electrical subs are not coordinated with the rest of the project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are trade overlap, missed rough-in points, access problems, inspection failures, and change orders from scope gaps. Electrical work often gets delayed when framing changes, HVAC routes move, or another trade blocks access after the electrical rough-in is planned. Good coordination reduces rework and keeps the project moving toward final inspection.
